text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this application is to outline the homeowner's intention of installing a 1.2m wrought iron fence and/or horizontal wooden fence in the front yard, followed by a horizontal wooden fence measuring 1.8m in height along the flankage yard with a section of the wooden fence running 90 degrees towards the home, near the side entrance. Additionally, the homeowners have requested to maintain the existing board on board fence in the rear yard, which currently poses a sightline obstruction. This also falls solely on City Property and should be addressed by Transportation Services.
